claim: First-hour has one mandatory resource/tool spine.
required_artifact: Route owner table; PlayMode quest progression capture/log
pass_condition: Only chosen spine gates first-hour progression; secondary resource does not block route.

claim: Starter loadout/unlock matches mandatory resource gate.
required_artifact: Player prefab/loadout asset inspection; runtime inventory/tool slot capture
pass_condition: Required tool is assigned or unlocked before matching node/objective; no debug grant.

claim: Copper can be collected if copper remains first-hour critical.
required_artifact: Route run log with position/depth/O2; inventory hash/quantity; node scar/depletion
pass_condition: Collect Data_Copper from authored source and return alive.

claim: Titanium can be collected if titanium remains first-hour critical.
required_artifact: Route run log with position/depth/O2; inventory hash/quantity; outcrop/node scar
pass_condition: Collect Data_TitaniumScrap after first_hour_exit_lifepod and return alive.

claim: Chosen first craft consumes actual runtime ingredients and emits expected result.
required_artifact: Recipe owner declaration; fabricator transaction log
pass_condition: Craft scanner or copper wire using declared runtime source; inventory delta matches recipe.

claim: Opening resource route is survivable but still oxygen-pressured.
required_artifact: Peak depth, route duration, min oxygen normalized, refill source, death/fail behavior
pass_condition: Player can complete route with nonzero O2 margin; overextension can still kill.

claim: Opening route remains bright, scenic, semi-open, and uneasy.
required_artifact: Compact and normal screenshots from start, midpoint, resource source, return landmark
pass_condition: Surface/photic route is readable and Subnautica-floor or better; no darkness/fog concealment.

claim: Death after first-hour collection/craft does not softlock progression.
required_artifact: Death test with starter tools, copper/titanium, copper wire/scanner, O2 item; respawn telemetry
pass_condition: Core tools persist; critical resources persist or are recoverable; quest state stays valid.

claim: Save/load preserves first-hour progress and world scars.
required_artifact: Save/load test log; inventory/quest/depleted-node/marker snapshot before and after
pass_condition: Inventory, quest state, resource depletion, and route markers survive load.

claim: Survival/respawn failures are explainable from telemetry.
required_artifact: Last-300-frame telemetry dump or accessible ring artifact
pass_condition: Death/failure has route, oxygen, depth, inventory, respawn sequence, and dropped count evidence.
